_about: High or critical npm advisories with no fixed release yet. scripts/check-cves.py lets these through and fails on any other. Remove an entry as soon as a fix ships. Checked 2026-10-18.

advisories.reason: No fixed release (3.0.3 is the latest). Comes in through Metro, the bundler that builds the app on a developer's computer or Expo's servers, and through Jest; it isn't in the app on phones, and only patterns written by the developers reach it.

No fixed release (1.4.0 is the latest). Comes in through @expo/code-signing-certificates in the Expo CLI and expo-updates' build tooling, used when signing updates at build time; it isn't in the app on phones.
